unifiedPagesRevision.deployment: Local changes only; publish the API and both clients together.
changes: One canonical /requests page per app; Admin sidebar has one requests entry. Type (including all), status and personal scope are URL-backed filters; paging retains applied filters and refresh/back preserve them. Ordinary roles always send personal scope.

Mixed request feed counts, orders and pages the three request tables in SQL, then reads at most one bounded detail projection per kind. Each row includes its kind; review/approve/reject/withdraw use the row kind, including stale-review refresh. Single-kind API contracts remain available.

Legacy addition/assignment/removal/history links redirect with matching filters and keep request-ID links; privileged request-ID history links retain global review access. Approval report drilldowns target the canonical page.

One distribution report selects area/year/birth month; old group routes redirect. Explicit missing-group labels and drilldowns include birthMonth=0. The current-student list now retains that missing-birthday filter.

One servant activity report selects custom period or the existing server-defined report week; old weekly route redirects. Existing row details and paging/sorting remain available. Three duplicate catalog entries and eight unreachable report source/template files removed.

Both API-scoped interceptors encode audit-reason headers explicitly; CallerContext decodes the marked URI value. Arabic body reasons and audited original text are preserved; legacy unmarked headers keep their existing behavior.

backend.coverage: Five roles: all-kind SQL union translation/count/stable paging, own/global scope and 403, detail parity including archived targets and prior single-kind contracts, withdrawal and Arabic audit reason round trip, invalid filters. dropdownAndFilterActionsRevision.deployment: Local frontend changes only; publish both clients. No API deployment is required for this revision.
changes: Shared resource pickers in both apps use searchable comboboxes with a bounded scroll list. Scrolling appends 25-item pages; next/previous buttons are removed from dropdowns. Existing table pagination remains available.

Only one additional-page request runs at a time. Search cancels superseded requests immediately, resets paging and debounces the replacement query. Query versions discard pending searches for a replaced resource kind; IDs are deduplicated and empty/non-advancing pages stop loading.

Additional-page failures retain loaded options and retry the failed page. Current selection stays named outside the loaded/search results, including externally supplied owner labels. Unassignment presents the empty choice rather than its internal sentinel.

Keyboard selection, Escape, Tab and click-away behavior preserve dialog focus. Scroll lists explicitly have tabindex=-1 to avoid Firefox automatically adding scroll containers to the tab order; dialog boundaries exclude negative-tabindex controls.

Filter action labels are تطبيق and مسح. One shared full-row action group keeps both buttons adjacent with 44px targets, equal typography and no wrapping, including the Servant student list and legacy advanced filters.
Shared theme tokens, RTL logical spacing, bounded list scrolling and wrapping long names apply in both apps. Form grids align their fields from the top while a dropdown is open.

core.coverage: Both apps; widths 320/360/390/430/768/1024/1440/1920, landscape and 200% text; scroll append, concurrent-scroll guards, selected IDs, cancellation/out-of-order search, retry/empty/failed/saving states, keyboard/modal focus, report filters and owner unassignment. Axe scans open dialogs at 390/1440px.

initialCombinedRun.detail: A WebKit enlarged-text geometry check read two button rectangles during continuing scrolling. The test now waits for fonts and reads both rectangles atomically; no application change was needed for that measurement failure.
